question: When a watch is sold at (7)/(8)th of the marked price, there is a profit of 25%. At what percentage more than the cost price has the marked price of the watch been fixed? [Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.]
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price = (7)/(8) x Marked Price

Profit % = 25%

**Formula used:**

Profit % = **{Profitover Cost Price} times 100**

Profit = SP - CP
